name: Martinique

findings.controller: Not stated (cable and terminal-equipment vendor unnamed in opened source)
findings.summary: Orange's Kanawa submarine cable, landing at Le Lamentin, Martinique and in French Guiana, was installed by Orange Marine and inaugurated; it interconnects with Americas II and ECFS. Orange's CEO put the investment at EUR 35 million.
findings.analyst_inference: Pole null because the opened source names no cable or optical-equipment vendor; under the equipment rule the vendor, not owner Orange (France), sets the pole. GLP-001 (prior run) attributes the Martinique-Guadeloupe optical platform to Infinera; not re-verified here. Article undated; 2019 inferred from its context (late-2018 announcement described as past). Pre-2020, still_current not confirmed. EUR value not converted.

findings.summary: A teleport at Le Lamentin hosting Eutelsat's OneWeb low-Earth-orbit gateway, with 14 LEO antennas, was inaugurated; Orange built it and operates it for Eutelsat, linking it to the Kanawa, SCF and ECFS cables. No value disclosed.
findings.analyst_inference: Controller taken as Eutelsat, which runs the OneWeb constellation the gateway serves and on whose behalf Orange operates the site; both are French, so pole third under the French-controller treatment used for GLP and BLM. Antenna and ground-equipment vendors not named. Two opened S3 sources but no S1/S2, so not corroborated.

facilities.null_reason: two searches returned only directory listings (Datacentermap, Inflect: Middle Caribbean Network site at Le Lamentin, S5, not cited); no dated data-centre or AI-campus project found

silicon.null_reason: no dedicated search; no accelerator purchase or deployment surfaced in other searches

applications.null_reason: one search found State-funded 35 extra videoprotection cameras in Fort-de-France (RCI, Mar 2022, opened) and a Regie Transports de Martinique videosurveillance framework tender (Mar 2026, max EUR 5m, opened); neither names a vendor or AI feature, so not coded

research_gaps: Radio/core equipment vendors for Orange, SFR Caraibe, Digicel AFG and Free Caraibe in Martinique, including 5G launched 18 February 2025 (opened RCI report names none); any application of the French 2019 L34-11 Huawei authorisation regime in Martinique.
Cable and optical-equipment vendors for Kanawa's Martinique landing (MTQ-001) and for the CaribbeanConnect cable reported in GLP-003 to land in Martinique.
